header.summary: I explore how thoughtful engineering can improve the way we understand and support the human body.

experience.description: I expanded Greensea's autonomy stack for a fleet of underwater robotics. This entailed localization, mapping, and obstacle avoidance for both holonomic and nonholonomic vehicles. Some projects I contributed towards are the following: EverClean (ship hull cleaning service), OPENSEA (hardware agnostic software for underwater robotics), Bayonet AUGV (sea floor surveying), and EOD (Explosive Ordnance Neutralization).

The main problem we were solving was related to multi-agent systems where we needed decisive coordination between multiple ground and air vehicles. I concentrated on sensor processing, mapping, and navigation for off-road ground automobiles.
I designed and implemented a data-driven nonlinear longitudinal and lateral controller for ground vehicles.
I designed, developed, and applied controls for a commercial vehicle. The team ultimately won 2nd place overall.

projects.title: Smart Health Dashboard
projects.description: A responsive Next.js dashboard that displays health metrics using custom visualizations and real-time data parsing. Designed to mimic medical device UI standards with clean typography and high-contrast accessibility styling.

projects.title: Wearable Prototype Analysis Toolkit
projects.description: A toolkit for analyzing prototype device outputs, featuring signal smoothing, calibration functions, and automated graph generation. Built for early-stage device iteration and testing workflows.

projects.title: Biomedical CAD Library
projects.description: A curated set of parametric SolidWorks models for connectors, housings, and testing fixtures used in medical device prototypes. Created to standardize rapid iteration across student and research teams.

projects.title: Lab Automation Script Suite
projects.description: A collection of Python scripts that streamline repetitive research tasks such as file naming, batch data cleaning, excel logging, and curve fitting for electrochemical experiments.

projects.title: Portfolio Redesign
projects.description: A fully custom, dark-themed personal portfolio inspired by Brittany Chiang. Built with responsive layouts, animated hover states, custom themes, and accessible components for a premium feel.

projects.title: Human-Centered Engineering Concept Study
projects.description: A conceptual exploration of biomedical design principles focusing on ergonomics, manufacturing constraints, and patient-centered usability for wearable and handheld devices.
